pr.title: Fix consensus race on all-container-exit path
pr.description:
Fixes a race condition where _run_concurrent_phase returns failure when all
containers exit with non-zero codes, without rechecking consensus. Also
improves the consensus wrapper's confirmation detection to check the message
bus when the tracker has stale state from withdrawal/re-proposal cascades.
Closes #1564.
pr.test_plan:
- Automated: test_consensus_complete_with_failures.py covers the race condition
- Automated: wrapper fallback test covers stale-tracker scenario
- Manual: Run a pipeline with concurrent agents, verify consensus detection works when containers exit before orchestrator detects consensus
